title: 信息日报 2026-08-11

headline.title: Meta 重返开源模型赛道，发布 30B 参数 Muse Glimmer
headline.summary: Meta 重返开源权重模型赛道，推出全新 30B 参数模型 Muse Glimmer，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。该模型针对端到端智能体任务做了优化，据称在本地模型所需的任务完成上表现优异。与之前复杂的 Llama 许可相比，新许可更宽松，预计将推动开源社区和私有部署的广泛应用。
headline.summary_en: Meta is back in the open-weights game with Muse Glimmer, a brand new 30B model released under a clean Apache 2.0 license. The model is optimized for end-to-end agentic task completion and achieves a strong success rate in local use. The permissive license is a step up from Meta’s earlier Llama licenses and is expected to accelerate adoption in open-source and on-premises deployments.
headline.reason: Meta 以宽松许可发布 30B 开源模型，标志着开源AI生态的重要回归，直接影响本地部署和智能体开发方向，影响面覆盖开发者、创业公司与研究者。
headline.reason_en: Meta’s return to open weights with a permissively licensed 30B model reshapes the open-source AI landscape and directly affects local deployment and agent development, making it the most consequential story of the day.
